description: Hidden clients run by the hub (up to 4): start joins server (host:port; default: the server_process one) or opens world {name, create?} and returns its instance; stop (username, or all); status. lite: small and frameless, for several clients. Online servers: sign_in (Microsoft device code), then start {account}. mod_profile {name, mods} for start {modProfile}. More (mods, windowSize, java, …): craftwire://docs/tools. First start downloads ~150 MB.
